cases.head: 1a4d8c1bb1e8f8e214ede7223bd2c05dc2ce006a
cases.label: Respect the choice-display setting in help.

changes.input: Run --help with string choices foo and bar and show_choices=False.
changes.support_reason: The change builds a help metavar from the choice types.

cases.head: 9c5e989d52509498ce78a4015ebc7d9408f70c56
cases.label: Trim decorator suffixes from generated command names.

changes.input: Decorate init_data_command with @click.command() and omit the name.
changes.support_reason: The change transforms a derived string.

cases.head: c326df95e9e3da0425360e030413f6a3ee25fdee
cases.label: Run close callbacks when explicitly exiting a context.

changes.input: Register a close callback and call Context.exit().
changes.before: Context.exit raises Exit without invoking close itself.
changes.after: Context.exit invokes close before raising Exit.
changes.support_reason: The change adds a call with a side effect.

cases.head: a1235aacb1be55dc66ddcfefbf64dec44b6ab54d
cases.label: Escape completion values containing colons when Zsh emits a description.

changes.input: Complete c:d with a help description in Zsh.
changes.before: The value is emitted as c:d.
changes.after: The value is emitted with the colon escaped as c\:d.
changes.support_reason: The change escapes a value via string operations.

cases.head: 884af5c20fdc95c9c7352df35c37273391464fb9
cases.label: Set implicit flag values when a type is supplied.

changes.input: Construct Option(['--foo'], is_flag=True, type=bool) with no explicit default or flag value.
changes.support_reason: The change moves an assignment across a type-dependent branch.

cases.head: b7cf06970e40a3144eb963ff34ed7c38934afb40
cases.label: Use the current nested group when resolving completion.

changes.input: Complete a command with nested groups get and full and leaf command data.
changes.before: The resolver reuses the enclosing group's remaining arguments, preventing correct nested completion.
changes.after: After get full, completion includes data.

cases.head: 0be2bd385064053bb75f92db317de128db729d52
cases.label: Omit the environment hint when no variable is configured.

changes.input: Generate an error hint with show_envvar=True and envvar=None.
changes.after: The hint omits the environment suffix.
changes.support_reason: The condition gains a Boolean conjunction and a None check.

cases.head: 7b72bfb8cd3a0cec38197f6786ed583b5b3737e7
cases.label: Type annotations expand to match existing exception formatting. The runtime formatting path is unchanged.

cases.head: eaf33a957975e7d0943fad8d2b4b905b6bd98cb9
cases.label: Render the Enum member name as the displayed option default.

changes.input: Show a default that is the member Color.RED of an Enum.
changes.before: For a plain Enum, the text includes Color.RED.
changes.after: The text uses the member name RED.
changes.support_reason: The change adds a type branch and attribute lookup.

cases.head: c88f333de440c5066ff563f784a6561f4713cf78
cases.label: Changelog entry only. The referenced StreamMixer fix landed in a separate PR.

cases.head: 1e110964736a95d822144390b99d7ecf17fca527
cases.label: Drop the spurious final empty string from text streaming.

changes.input: Iterate the text of a response streaming b'Hello,' and b' world!'.
changes.before: Two text chunks are followed by an empty string.
changes.after: Only the two text chunks are yielded.
changes.support_reason: The change spans decoder buffering and streaming.

cases.head: 6d852d319acd5d97caf14037dff15ede04b37542
cases.label: Apply the client timeout to manually constructed requests.

changes.input: Send a standalone request to the slow-response route with an AsyncClient timeout of 1e-6 seconds.
changes.before: The request has no client timeout extension.
changes.after: The client supplies the timeout and the slow response raises TimeoutException.
changes.support_reason: The change adds a helper call and updates a request extension.

cases.head: 12be5c44caa7a34bfe19f82eace5150ddeba2612
cases.label: Accept the socks5h proxy scheme.

changes.input: Construct Client(proxy='socks5h://localhost/') with SOCKS support installed.
changes.support_reason: The change extends scheme membership checks.

cases.head: 3f76571d3429497c4ee4ecf5d8bc034b6f765957
cases.label: Explicit request params replace the query in the URL.

changes.after: The resulting URL has an empty query.
changes.support_reason: The change replaces a merge call with a constructor argument.

cases.head: 9fd6f0ca6616d0310a3ee0b0c6ef509a97995797
cases.label: Change JSON byte serialization and reject non-finite numbers.

changes.before: The body is b'{"test": 123}' and Content-Length is 13.
changes.after: The body is b'{"test":123}' and Content-Length is 12.

changes.input: Build a JSON body containing an accented French character.
changes.before: The character is written as an ASCII escape.
changes.after: The character is written as UTF-8 bytes.

changes.input: Build a JSON body with a NaN value.

cases.head: ba2e51215e4e619540f2a24282b84ed8a738e6fd
cases.label: Change escaping for query parameters passed as key-value pairs.

changes.support_reason: The change spans URL escaping helpers.

cases.head: eeb5e3c2a3ff2403ec47b5926715ecd61143d92d
cases.label: Removes a test case. The library source is unchanged.

cases.head: e9cabc8e1deb6548c5c5e2f453e343d39a2a5321
cases.label: Load optional runtime modules at their point of use.

changes.input: Import httpx in a fresh process without certifi and httpcore already imported.
changes.before: The initial import loads certifi and httpcore.
changes.after: The initial import defers both modules until the relevant operations are needed.
changes.support_reason: The change moves imports into methods.

cases.head: 66225539796d819b5114ead2fd5e4d61865ab708
cases.label: Narrow the Request method parameter to strings.

changes.after: The explicit ASCII decode is gone and the constructor stores b'GET'.
changes.support_reason: The change removes a conditional conversion across multiple lines.
